name: Styx
source:
Your first impression of him was awful, the second not much better... But hey, third time's the charm, right?

Not much is known about Styx. He is a mysterious demon with secrets he is not ready to share.

Drinking human blood to live he is considered their natural enemy but is he really the evil stories make it to be?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3936920/The_Demons_Apple__Otome_Game/]Steam[/url]]
